# Modules that are INTENTIONALLY red, one Lake target per line.
#
# The breaker/builder discipline in AGENTS.md has a phase in which a frozen
# red battery exists and its implementation does not. During that phase the
# default build cannot be green, and a trust gate whose control step demands
# a green build cannot run at all.
#
# This file makes that phase explicit rather than letting the gate abort. It
# is self-checking in both directions: an undeclared failure fails the gate,
# and a declared module that is actually GREEN also fails the gate, so an
# entry cannot outlive the red phase it describes.
#
# Removing the last entry restores the original all-green control.
#
# P0: no entries. No packet was frozen yet.
#
# P3 queue-with-sizes and queuing strategies, frozen 2026-09-02 by the P3
# breaker seat. Packet: test/contracts/queue-with-sizes.contract.md.
# Implementation fence: Whatwg/Streams/Data/Queue.lean and
# Whatwg/Streams/Data/Strategy.lean. WhatwgTest.Streams.Data.QueueContract and
# WhatwgTest.Streams.Data.QueueAxiomReport were red here while the names they
# ascribe did not exist. The P3 builder seat landed that surface and removed
# the two entries; no entry remains.

# P4a default-readable representative, frozen 2026-09-05.
# Packet: test/contracts/readable-default.contract.md.
# Root/audit integration is the coordinator's separate landing change.
# Both modules became green with the P4a implementation; no entries remain.

# Promise census packet, frozen 2026-09-06 by the promise census breaker seat.
# Packets: test/contracts/census-profile-identity.contract.md,
# test/contracts/webidl-census.contract.md, test/contracts/ecma262-census.contract.md.
# Implementation fence: Gates/Census.lean (the R-P1 source profile, the R-P2
# kinds, the R-P4 rules.tsv end locator, the webidl and ecma262 standards),
# Gates/Ecmarkup.lean, census/webidl/**, census/ecma262/**, and the four
# generated projections those two standards write. Each module below is red
# only because the names it ascribes do not exist yet; the Web IDL and ECMA-262
# projection gates additionally refuse because no standard is registered under
# their key. The builder removes an entry the moment its battery is green.
#
# The Web IDL builder landed the R-P1 profile refactor, the R-P2 kinds, the
# R-P4 end locator, the webidl standard and census/webidl/** on 2026-09-06, so
# WhatwgTest.Audit.CensusProfileIdentity and
# WhatwgTest.Audit.WebIdl.CensusContract are green and their two entries are
# removed. WhatwgTest.Audit.Ecma262.CensusContract stayed red until the ES2026
# builder landed Gates/Ecmarkup.lean, the ecmarkup dispatch arm of
# Gates.Census.build and the ecma262 standard on 2026-09-07; that battery is
# green and its entry is removed. No entry remains, so the trust gate's
# all-green control is restored.
